描述_EN: when the fragment catches the light, the pattern stands out because of the diagonal feel to the weave structure, known as twill damask. it has a small all-over leaf pattern, which is rather hard to discern. this fragment was one of the very first east asian textiles to be acquired by the victoria and albert museum. this piece was originally exported from china or central asia to be used in a european church treasury.
描述_ZN: 当这块碎片映入眼帘时，由于编织结构的对角线感觉，这个图案很突出，被称为斜纹绫。 它有一个小的全面的叶子图案，这是很难辨别的。 这块碎片是维多利亚和阿尔伯特博物馆最早收购的东亚纺织品之一。 这块碎片最初是从中国或中亚出口的，用于欧洲的一个教堂库房。
